fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 28 piercing damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Bell-Struck Plate
fusions.desc: Rings the target's armour with the tines for 12 blunt damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Schiltron
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 15%.

fusions.name: Hedge of Steel
fusions.desc: Conjures plate set with forward-facing tines: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
